title: formatNear rounds 0.999 NEAR up to 1.00
details: formatNear goes through Number, so big yocto amounts lose precision and 0.999 NEAR shows as "1.00 NEAR". It must never round up: cut to 2 decimals using BigInt. formatNear("999999999999999999999999") should be "0.99 NEAR" and formatNear("123456789012345678901234567890") should be "123456.78 NEAR".
